newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO'S COSTA MAKES COMPLAINT AGAINST WEAH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO'S COSTA MAKES COMPLAINT AGAINST WEAH.

text.p: Porto defender Jorge Costa has lodged a formal complaint with police against AC Milan striker George Weah who butted him and broke his nose after a European Cup match last month.
The complaint, which could end in a trial, has been handed to the Judicial Police in Oporto, Portuguese news agency Lusa reported.
Costa needed surgery after the incident in the player's tunnel at the end of a bad-tempered game in Porto on November 20.
Weah has admitted the assault but he says that Costa provoked him with a series of dangerous fouls during the game and by making repeated racist insults.
The Liberian striker has already been suspended for one game by UEFA while they carry out their own investigation.
Portuguese international Costa could seek more than $1 million in damages from the African, according to newspaper reports.
